section_summary.extract_value: This procedures section describes a single study (Study X) recruiting 253 female participants (aged 18-50) through online advertisements on Facebook and email invitations. Participants completed self-report questionnaires via an online survey after providing informed consent, with 59 participants excluded based on gender and age criteria from an initial sample of 312.
